description: Source code for a firmware utility tool for TP-Link devices, including functions for creating, inspecting, and extracting firmware images, with detailed handling of firmware headers, regions, and layout configurations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line options and orchestrating firmware creation or inspection.

methods.name: fill_header
methods.description: Fills a firmware header structure with current configuration data, including version, vendor, hardware info, region, and MD5 checksum.

methods.name: inspect_fw
methods.description: Inspects a firmware file, verifies headers, computes MD5, and optionally extracts kernel and rootfs images.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options.

methods.name: check_options
methods.description: Validates command-line options and input files, computes derived values, and prepares for firmware build or inspection.
